text.zh: 变异的虚空虫表现出极高的侵略性。
text.en: The Mutated Voidworms appear very aggressive.

text.zh: 变异的虚空虫表现出一定侵略性。

default.zh: 变异的虚空虫表现出温顺。

text.zh: 沿着路继续向前，我们撞见了某种球状两栖生物的巢穴，其附近的空气中有一种奇怪的非自然粒子在不停地震荡。我们尚且不清楚为什么这些粒子对这种生物有着如此的吸引力，但我们相信只要投入一丁点工作，就能将这些粒子稳定并利用起来。
text.en: Following it we come across the den of a bulbous amphibian creature, with vibrant, oddly unnatural particles vibrating through in the air around it. It is unclear why these particles are so attracted to the creature, but we believe that with a little work, we can stabilize and make use of them ourselves.

text.zh: 随着我们继续探险，我们在更深处发现了一处紧凑的设施，其中有几个房间，里面的机器被放在一边用于稳定易爆微粒。尽管目前是安全的，这些机器很快就会达到亟需修理的临界状态；我们应当集中我们的努力将其恢复正常，以免这些机器工作到散架。
text.en: As we continued our explorations, we discovered a compact facility further below, with several rooms and machines set aside for stabilizing volatile motes. Though safe for now, they will soon reach a critical stage of disrepair, and we should focus our efforts on restoring them before they fall apart.

text.zh: 这个房室引导我们前往地下更深处，我们最终走到了一个人工洞穴，里面满是有毒的废料，慢慢地侵蚀着地面。尽管充满危险，但似乎这里就是我们先前发现的易爆微粒的来源。只要我们小心地执行稳定化流程，我们应当可以对此地加以利用。
text.en: The chamber leading us further underground, we eventually came across a grotto filled with toxic waste, slowly eating away at the ground. Though dangerous, it seems to be the source of the volatile motes we discovered earlier. We should be able to make use of these, as long as we are careful with the stabilization process.

text.zh: 它似乎与一个流动在地表下来源不明的电流相连。更重要的是，我们无法确定电流会持续多久，是否稳定，但我们相信我们可以利用它。
text.en: It seems to have been attached to an electric current running below the surface, the origin of which remains unclear.  What's more, we have no way to determine how long the current will last, or if it is entirely stable, but we believe we can make use of it.

text.zh: 它似乎是为了维持一台古老的发电机运转而建造并隐藏在地表之下的。尽管存在很多设备问题，我们可以认定发电机仍运行良好。再费些功夫，我们应该就能够稳定它并为我们所用。
text.en: It appears to have been built to keep an archaic generator alive and hidden just below the surface, and despite all the equipment problems one might expect the generator appears to be running fine. With some work, we should be able to stabilize it and make use of it ourselves.

text.zh: 当进一步观察神秘的发电机时，我们发现它连接在几条贯穿[FromFromFrom.GetName]的大电缆上。整个大家伙似乎都是由一个位于地表以下的单一设备运行的。只需对电流稍作修改，我们就可以利用它产生的能量。
text.en: When we looked further into the mysterious generator, we found it is attached to several large cables running throughout [FromFromFrom.GetName]. The whole thing seems to be run by a single apparatus housed far below the surface. With only a slight modification to the current, we can probably make use of the energy it creates.

text.zh: 我们发现它引向了一个远在地表之下的房室。在那里我们看到活体金属和某个我们认为过去是软体类的生物，以一种令人瞠目结舌的方式聚结在了一起。这两种事物已经融合在了一起，沿着地底下的洞穴网络慢慢地向外延伸。通过一定的努力，我们或许可以在不对这个生物造成太大伤害的前提下，小心地凿落一些金属的碎片。
text.en: We have discovered that it leads to a chamber further below the surface. There we chanced upon a beguiling amalgamation of living metal and what we believe was once a molluscoid creature. It seems the two have fused together, slowly expanding through the cavern networks below the ground. With some effort, we should be able to start chipping pieces off the metal, for our own uses, without doing the creature too much harm.

text.zh: 我们没有花太多功夫，就发现活体金属集中在一个狭窄的人工房室中。由于它会滑动，并且对触碰能够产生反应，我们相信它的生命程度比我们一开始料想得要更高。如果我们对它小心地收集，我们能够在不杀死这个生物的前提下，最大程度地利用它。
text.en: It didn't take long for us to find the living metal is centered on a narrow grotto. As it slithers and reacts to touch, we believe it might be more alive than one might first think. If we harvest it carefully, we should be able to maximize our use of the creature, without killing it.

text.zh: 我们在最复杂演算中检测到其存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的电路中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。
text.en: We detect its presence in our most complex calculations. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our circuits.

default.zh: 我们可以在思绪的最深处感受到祂的存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的脑中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。
default.en: We feel its presence in our deepest thoughts. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our minds.

text.zh:
这合金。这重量。这光泽。这光芒！你以前见过这样的合金吗？难以置信的屈变力。简直就是最高等级。不包含任何杂质。我们能够感受到它。它正在召唤你。

我们能为你提供£alloys£ 2000$alloys$，
text.en:
This alloy. The weight. The lustre. The glow! Have you ever seen such metallic bonding? Incredible yield strength. Maximum grade. Nominal impurities. We can feel it. It calls to you.

We will give to you £alloys£ 2000 $alloys$,

text.zh:
这些异星天然气，绝品啊！为了运输方便我们将其压缩到最大密度。不过注意了，它们十分不稳定！你肯定想要这些燃料吧？给你的护盾供能？还是你的大炮？现在它们就是你的了。

我们能为你提供£exotic_gases£ 150$exotic_gases$，
text.en:
These exotic gases. Effervescent. Compressed to maximum density, for logistical convenience. Highly volatile - careful! You desire them, do you not? For your shields, your plasma cannons? They can be yours.

We will give you £exotic_gases£150 $exotic_gases$,

text.zh:
这种金属不断移动，流动，重构，嘶！我们自己就发现了很多种用途。你肯定也会找到它的用途。

我们能为你提供£sr_living_metal£ 40$sr_living_metal$，
text.en:
This metal. It moves. It flows. It reconstructs, kssk! We have found many uses for it. We are certain you shall, too.

We will give you £sr_living_metal£  40 $sr_living_metal$,

text.zh: 我们的社会已经开始发生变化。我们的思想与战争的欲望相冲突。这种认知失调在素来和平的人群中引起了极大的不适。我们选择对了吗？
text.en: Changes in our society are already emerging. Our minds are in conflict with a taste for battle. This cognitive dissonance is causing great discomfort among our normally peaceful population. Have we made the right choice?

text.zh: 我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事[GetIndividualNamePlural]无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。
text.en: Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military [GetIndividualNamePlural] are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest they turn to needless aggression.

text.zh: 我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。
text.en: Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military units are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.

default.zh: 我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。
default.en: Changes in our society are already apparent. Our military personnel are ever hungrier for battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in strenuous training, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.

text.zh: 我们同一个能够帮助我们的国家签署了科研协议。
text.en: We have at least one research agreement with an empire able to help us.

default.zh: 我们尚且没有同任何能够帮助我们的国家签署科研协议。
default.en: We don't have a research agreement with an empire able to help us.

text.zh: 现在到了讨论报酬的时候了。我们和……一些执法部门闹了些不愉快。都是小细节。并不重要。但是我们需要一些人来做我们的证人，一些帮助，一些正直的人来为我们撑腰！强大而充满智慧的你们愿意为我们这些可怜的商人做担保吗，值得信任，非常无辜，我们只不过是稍微没注意做错了一点事，结果就被监管部门给盯上了嘶。
text.en: Now. For the cost. We have... run afoul of some legalities. Minor details. Very trivial. But we would require some witness, some support. An upstanding face, to back our cause! Would your strong and wise nation vouch for us, poor trustworthy traders, very innocent, whose only mistake was a distraction of the mind, a mere oversight that led to the transgression of some pesky kssk legislature?

text.zh: 给我们£exotic_gases£ 15$exotic_gases$，然后我们立马布置卫星！
text.en: Give us £exotic_gases£ 15 $exotic_gases$, and we will deploy this satellite!

text.zh: 我们会为你们布置这颗卫星！前提是你先给我们£consumer_goods£ 100$consumer_goods$。
text.en: We will deploy this satellite for you! If you grant us £consumer_goods£ 100 $consumer_goods$.

text.zh: 人人都在做“梦”，休眠循环变成了混乱的数据流。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，威胁着他们的健康。
text.en: These 'dreams' are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of disrupted data streams. Sufferers recall visions of otherworldly strangeness that represent extreme danger to their wellbeing.

text.zh: 我们开始体验到通常认为个体意识称之为“梦”的东西。这种现象的患者报告说，他们看到了可以对我们的集体构成根本威胁的不属于这个世界的奇异幻景。
text.en: We have begun experiencing what we think singular consciousnesses call 'dreams.' Sufferers of this phenomenon report visions of otherworldly strangeness that represent fundamental threats to our collective.

text.zh: 人人都在做噩梦，休眠循环变成了麻木的不安。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，直击每个人最原始的恐惧。
text.en: Bad dreams are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of unquiet stupor. Sufferers recall visions of terrifying, otherworldly strangeness that express their most primal fears.

default.zh: 人人都在做噩梦，休眠循环变成了麻木的不安。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，直击每个人最原始的恐惧。
default.en: Bad dreams are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of unquiet stupor. Sufferers recall visions of terrifying, otherworldly strangeness that express their most primal fears.

text.zh: [Capital.GetName]上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们也能向集体以外的易感意识传输认知信息。
text.en: Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on [Capital.GetName] have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness, not only to our own collective.

text.zh: [Owner.Capital.GetName]上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们可以向易感意识传输认知信息。
text.en: Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on [Owner.Capital.GetName] have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness.

default.zh: [Owner.Capital.GetName]上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们可以向易感意识传输认知信息。
default.en: Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on [Owner.Capital.GetName] have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness.

text.en: We, the last remnants of our order, have

text.zh: 我们发现自己处于$the_instrument_of_desire_article$与$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的领域之间。
text.en: We find ourselves between the domains of $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ and $the_cradle_of_souls_article$.

default.zh: 我们发现自己处于虚境之中主要实体的领域之间。
default.en: We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

text.zh: 如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用决议来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。
text.en: Should we desire to compete for the title of market host, we have a few years to use Decisions to nominate one of our worlds to tether the $galactic_market_station$.

text.zh: 我们没有星球可以作为$galactic_market_station$的锚地，因此我们无法承担东道主之责。但无论该空间站选址何处，我们都可自由参与贸易。
text.en: Our people have no world to offer as the $galactic_market_station$'s anchor, and so we cannot compete for the role of market host. We may yet trade freely through whichever port the station calls home.

default.zh: 如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用决议来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。
default.en: Should we desire to compete for the title of market host, we have a few years to use Decisions to nominate one of our worlds to tether the $galactic_market_station$.

text.zh: 长期封闭正在削弱子个体的适应性。让它们在下方的定居点轮转，穿越陌生的地形与环境，将能恢复其性能。
text.en: Prolonged confinement is degrading drone adaptability. Cycling them through the settlement below, across unfamiliar terrain and conditions, will restore performance.

default.zh: 船员们需要休息。我们将停靠港口，给船员们一些时间去踏上并非他们亲手建造的土地，去见见他们还不认识的面孔。
default.en: The crew needs a break. We'll make port and and give the crew time to walk ground they didn't build and see faces they don't already know.

text.zh: 甚至比$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$而言，他们的协议都更难以捉摸。
text.en: Far more so than $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$, their protocols are obscure.

text.zh: 有些人拥有与[GetChosenPatron]媲美的力量，尽管他们的意图大相径庭。
text.en: Some possess power comparable to the [GetChosenPatron], though they are vastly different in their intent.

text.zh: 200$pop_cat_specialist$£pop£人口！我们需要人来帮忙记账。
text.en: 200 $pop_cat_specialist$ £pop£ Pops! We need some help with the bookkeeping.

text.zh: £unity£ 500$unity$！对时代精神的机械化领悟的过程基本上无法理解，而且会让人很不安，不过倒是完全无害。
text.en: £unity£ 500 $unity$! The mechanical process of zeitgeist absorption is poorly understood and can be unnerving, but it is completely harmless.

text.zh: 六个月获取了£society£ $society_research$！我们很想知道你到底怎么做到的？
text.en: six months of £society£ $society_research$! How do you do the things you do? We intend to find out.

text.zh: £science_ship£ 1科研船！不包括船员。我们不需要他们，不要。
text.en: £science_ship£ 1 Science Ship! Excluding the crew. We don't need them, no.

text.zh: -200$pop$£pop£人口！任何类型的人口都行，真的。令人兴奋的医疗研发机会在等着他们！如你所见，我们最近也开始扩展招募服务的业务了。
text.en: -200$pop$ £pop£ Pops! Any kind of Pop will do, really. Exciting medical development opportunities await them! We've recently expanded into recruitment services, you see.

text.zh: 我们可以从哪怕如此恐怖的力量中学习。
text.en: We can learn, even from this dreadful power.

text.zh: 定居点已开放其公共场所。子个体将会部署出动，在向乘客推出之前，先在当地居民身上实地测试实验性的娱乐程序。
text.en: The settlement has opened its public venues. Drones will deploy to field-test experimental entertainment routines on the local population before rolling them out for passengers.

default.zh: 定居点已向船员开放其露天剧场、广场和公共舞台。
default.en: The settlement has opened its amphitheaters, plazas, and public stages to the crew.

text.zh: 这是一种暴力且不和谐之物。它违背了无数我们最珍视的价值。不建议进一步和$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$这个东西调和。
text.en: It is a thing of violence and discord. It stands against many of our most valued principles. Attuning further with this being, $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$, is not recommended.

text.zh: ，知道了祂关于残暴与荣耀的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]重新充能，就可以与这个实体，$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$接触、交流了。
text.en: We know its vision of violence and glory. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$.

default.zh: ，知道了祂关于残暴与荣耀的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$接触、交流了。
default.en: We know its vision of violence and glory. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$.

text.zh: 随着[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]掌权，该联邦将繁荣起来。
text.en: With the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] at the helm, this Federation will prosper.

text.zh: 齐心协力，我们将更加富强。“我们”当然是指[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]。
text.en: Together we grow stronger. 'We' meaning of course the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName].

text.zh: 你当然明白。毕竟我们确确实实赢了。
text.en: Surely you understand. We did win, after all.

text.zh: 这样，整个联邦将从我们的共同努力中受益。
text.en: This way the entire Federation will benefit from our joint effort.

text.zh: 很明显，如果要公平地分配这些财富，我们必须亲自动手。
text.en: It's evident that if this wealth is to be fairly distributed, we must do it ourselves.
Wealth! Don't take it - make it!

text.zh: 贪婪对任何人都没有好处。
text.en: Being greedy will not help anyone.

text.zh: 恳请你，收下吧。我们不希望承担这尘世财富的重担。
text.en: Please, take it. We wish not to carry the burden of mundane riches.

text.zh: 也许这可以让你看到生活的真正价值，而不是盲目地盯着毫无意义的数字和金条。
text.en: May this allow you to see the true value of life, rather than staring blindly at pointless numbers and bars.

text.zh: 这将创建一个更强大，更统一的联邦。
text.en: This will create a stronger and more unified Federation.

text.zh: 既然已经清楚了谁是领袖，请随意使用你的财富，只要你觉得合适。
text.en: Now that it has become evident who the leader is, feel free to use your wealth as you see fit.

text.zh: 我们将利用这些财富让我们更强大，并惠及联邦全体。
text.en: We will use this wealth to strengthen ourselves, and in effect the whole Federation.

text.zh: 你当然明白。毕竟我们确确实实赢了。
text.en: Surely you understand. We did win, after all.

text.zh: 给吧。没有必要为此争斗下去。
text.en: There. No need to fight over it anymore.

text.zh: 要论以建设性的方式使用这笔钱，谁又比[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]更懂呢？
text.en: Who better than the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] to make sure it's spent in a constructive manner?
After all, we are all in this together!

text.zh: 有了这笔资金，我们甚至可以到达更远的地方。
text.en: With this funding we may expand our horizons even further.

text.zh: 现在我们都可以从中受益。全靠我们自己。
text.en: Now we can all benefit from it. All by ourselves.

text.zh: 已经做出决定。我们没有遗憾，我们绝不道歉。
text.en: The decision has been made. We have no regrets and we make no apologies.
All is one. One is all.

text.zh: 财务分配例行程序已启动。

为获得最佳净收益，建议采取的措施：
最大获取。
text.en:
Suggested action for optimal net gain:
Maximum Acquisition.

text.zh: 这台发电机连接到一处埋藏于底下的矿脉，其中可能蕴藏着对这台机器的运转者而言至关重要的原材料资源。尽管已经快要枯竭，我们仍可以将这些资源据为己有。
text.en: The generator is attached to a mineral vein buried below ground, once probably an important source of raw material for whoever was in charge of the machine's operations. Though somewhat diminished, we can make use of these resources ourselves.

text.zh: 进一步的探索发现这座发电机连接到了一处昏暗的、蕴藏着一些小型矿脉的人工洞穴。在地面上四处散布着一种此前未知的石质物种的尸体。目前还不清楚他们是在开采这些矿物，还是直接在地里开吃，但不管怎么样，他们身上密布的矿物突起对我们可能相当有使用价值。
text.en: Further exploration revealed the generator is connected to a dim grotto complete with several smaller veins of minerals. Scattered about the floor were the bodies of a previously unknown lithoid species. It is unclear if they were harvesting the minerals or eating them straight from the ground, but in either case the bodies are encrusted with mineral protrusions that may well prove useful to us.

text.zh: 这座发电机建立于一处巨大的地下洞穴中，填满了各种各样的矿物。很可能这整座巨大的洞穴就是被它自己给挖空的。它可能是出于对深入行星地壳的需求的结果而进行的挖掘。
text.en: The generator is built within a gigantic underground chamber, filled to the brim with minerals of all kinds. Emptying the grotto is going to be an endeavor in itself. Digging is likely to result in the need to push deeper into the world's crust.

text.zh: 我们已经挣脱了来自前宗主的锁链，但征途不会到此为止，我们将在星海共同体的参议院中向所有仍想剥削利用前超光速文明的国家开展斗争。
text.en: Our former masters are no more, but our goal doesn't change: on the Senate Floor of the Galactic Community, we will fight all those who wish to exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

text.zh: 我们已经挣脱了来自前宗主的锁链，但征途不会到此为止，我们将在星海共同体的参议院中向所有仍想剥削利用前超光速文明的国家开展斗争。
text.en: Our former masters are no more, but our goal doesn't change: on the Senate Floor of the Galactic Community, we will fight all those who wish to exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

text.zh: 为了诱使他们多留几年，我们得给予一些激励。不要小看蝇头小利的力量。
text.en: To entice them to stay on a few more years, we might offer an incentive. Never underestimate the power of a well-placed bribe.

text.zh: 我们可以提醒他们这里乐趣多多，或许可以提供一些具体的例子来鼓励他们留下来。
text.en: We could remind them of the many pleasures here, and perhaps provide a few discrete examples as an incentive to stay.

text.zh: 好吧，如果他们坚持要回家的话我们也别无选择，只能告知他们的政府他们参与了违法的异星关系。
text.en: Well, if they insist on returning home, we have no choice but to inform their government about the illicit xeno-relations they were engaging in.

text.zh: 我们可以预留政府津贴来资助这个项目。这应该能让他们分心一段时间。
text.en: We could set aside a government stipend to fund this project. That should keep them distracted for a while longer.

text.zh: 定居点的娱乐区提供了从未体验过的刺激。子个体穿梭于人群、游戏和盛况之中，收集数据以更新飞船自身的娱乐程序。
text.en: The settlement's entertainment district offers unfamiliar stimuli. Drones are cycling through the crowds, the games, the spectacle, collecting data to update the ship's own recreational programming.

default.zh: 当地娱乐区现已营业。船员们正轮班登陆星球，在游戏厅和竞技场里碰碰运气。
default.en: The local entertainment district is open for business. Crew shifts are rotating planetside to try their luck at game halls and spectator arenas.

text.en: Truth is in the depths below.

text.zh: 而在虚境之中，生死皆为无相。
text.en: In the Shroud, there will be no life or death.

text.zh: 我们的存在将超越生命。

text.en: We trace these lines in dreams.
Death will no longer concern us.

text.zh: 我们向往彼岸之景跨过这座桥。
text.en: We cross to reach the other side.
Enables adoption of the $ap_galactic_hyperthermia$ Ascension Perk.

text.zh: 一股强大的神经反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且侵入了全体[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]共用的群体灵能链接。
text.en: A powerful neural backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and into the communal psionic link that is shared between all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

default.zh: 一股强大的灵能反噬沿着我们与虚境建立的传导通路袭来，而且侵入了全体[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]共用的群体灵能链接。
default.en: A powerful psychic backlash has bounced back through our conduit with the Shroud, and into the communal psionic link that is shared between all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

text.zh: 各层甲板上的子个体将化身为来自下方星球的叛逃者，在完美的协同下，向不同的乘客群体同时提供机密简报。
text.en: Drones across every deck will adopt defector personas from the planet below, delivering parallel clandestine briefings to different passenger groups in perfect coordination.

default.zh: 我们正在策划一场全舰范围的情报行动。船员志愿者将被安插在各个甲板上，作为“叛逃者”向乘客小组输送机密简报。
default.en: We are staging a ship-wide intelligence operation. Crew volunteers will be planted across all decks as 'defectors' feeding classified briefings to passenger cells.

text.zh: 范格利牌双层床！这些创新的、节约空间的、可折叠的“休眠插座”能提升星球的居住容纳量，让你可以每平米“挤进”更多的人！
text.en: Trium-brand bunk beds! These innovative, space-efficient, stackable "rest receptacles" increase the habitation potential of planetary housing, allowing you to "squeeze in" more capita per square meter!

text.zh:
范格利牌食品容器！你是否厌倦了殖民地人民任由各种蔬果生鲜慢慢腐烂，仅因为他们的消化系统一时难以负担？

把这个容器空投到你选的殖民地，它可以收集各种各样的食物，并且持续保鲜。有了它就完全不用担心食品浪费的问题，因为它可以将食品通通保存起来，不但解决了食品浪费，也解决了食品需求的问题。
text.en:
Trium-brand food storage containers! Is your administration tired of colonists letting perfectly digestible vegetable or animal matter decompose in their domiciles because their digestive systems can only process so much input at a time?

Air-dropped onto a colony of your choice, these semi-transparent, lidded containers hermetically seal cooked or raw foods, keeping the contents fresh for longer. This is the perfect way to preserve leftovers as delicious and/or nominally nutritious snacks for later, dramatically reducing food waste and, ergo, food needs.

text.zh:
范格利牌大气层除臭器！你的农耕地盘是不是闻起来臭臭的？你的大都市是不是闻起来“拜托，不要了！”你的殖民地恶臭吗？

交给我们就好了，我们的气雾剂与微生物混合的专利产品能够清理所有宜居对流层。坐好，放松，安上我们的除臭器，清新空气自然来。
text.en:
a Trium-brand atmospheric deodorizer! Do your agri-worlds smell like fertilizer? Is your ecumenopolis more like a "yuck, ew, no please?" Does your colony stink?

We have the solution! Our patented blend of microbes and aerosol reagents will clear the air of any habitable troposphere. Just sit back, relax, deploy the strato-drones, and enjoy the fresh air.

text.zh: 上好的范格利小玩意收藏套装！这里面全是时尚艳丽的小玩意儿，肯定会让你成为全场瞩目的焦点。
text.en: the exclusive Trium Bauble Collection! This assortment of fashionable trinkets and gewgaws is sure to both dazzle and distract your populace.

text.zh: 范格利集团销售技术团队。将会部署于你的帝国的每一个行星基地，他们将会增长你所有星系的$r_trade$收益。（眼红的对手们可能会用“人为通胀”来形容这一过程）
text.en: a contingent of Vengralian Trium sales technicians. Stationed across the starbases of your empire, they will adjust upward (jealous competitors would say "artificially inflate") the $r_trade$ of all systems.

text.zh: 范格利牌孵化池刺激素！厌烦了等待你的幼虫，或是准幼虫的幼体变成成体，或是准成虫的成体了吗？用这些超级安全的刺激素来加速其成长吧！
text.en: Trium-brand Spawning Pool Stimulators! Tired of waiting for your larvae or larvae-equivalent young to become imago or imago-equivalent adults? Increase their development speed with these super-safe stimulants!

text.zh: 数个手提箱没有被标记的£energy£ $energy$！总共£energy£ 2000$energy$。希望你和我们一样兴奋！
text.en: several suitcases worth of unmarked £energy£ $energy$! That's £energy£ 2000 $energy$ in total. Are you as excited as we are? We hope so.

text.zh: 调查团队发现封层存在弱点，破开后，响声瞬间震耳欲聋，导致子个体感官过载，认知崩溃。
text.en: The survey team found a weakness in the seal and broke through, at which point the ringing became deafening, causing sensory overload and cognitive breakdown among drones.

default.zh: 调查团队发现封层存在弱点，破开后，响声瞬间震耳欲聋，引起队员恐慌愤怒。
default.en: The survey team found a weakness in the seal and broke through, at which point the ringing became deafening, causing panic attacks and fits of rage among the team.

text.zh: 我们的心智立刻拒绝了祂关于秩序与和谐的虚假前提。不建议进一步和$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$这个东西调和。
text.en: Our minds immediately reject its false premises of order and harmony. Attuning further with this being, $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$, would weaken our resolve.

text.zh: 知道了祂关于秩序与和谐的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]重新充能，就可以与这个实体，$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$接触、交流了。
text.en: We know its vision of order and harmony. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$.

default.zh: 知道了祂关于秩序与和谐的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$接触、交流了。
default.en: We know its vision of order and harmony. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$.

text.zh:
随着我们星系的地位逐渐提高，虚境成为我们军火库的一种驱动力。意志薄弱者将继续失败，而我们会加强与那个超出他们理解的力量间的联系。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

As we strengthen our position in the galaxy, the Shroud is a driving force in our arsenal. Those of a lesser consciousness will continue to fail, as we bolster our connection to a power beyond their comprehension.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

default.zh:
我们的意识还在延展，与虚境的联系也在随之与日俱增。在面对我们的的持续演化，一个迟滞、破碎的星系毫无可能战胜我们的伟大联合。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
default.en:
Our mind continues to expand, and our connection to the Shroud along with it. In the face of our continued evolution, a stagnant, disconnected galaxy stands no chance against our great union.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

text.zh: 当我们的专家在此处的废墟中梳理时，他们找到了一些几乎完好无损的舰船部件。虽然在长久的年岁中劣化失效，但我们的工程师相信他们可以从中筛选出一些信息
text.en: When they were combing through the ruins of the place, our specialists managed to find some mostly intact ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, our engineers believe they can sift some information from them.

text.zh: 在梳理废墟时，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些舰船部件。尽管由于长期劣化而不堪使用，但我们相信还是可以从中筛选出一些信息。
text.en: As we combed the ruins, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon several ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, we believe we can sift some information from the pieces.

text.zh: 尽管此处颇为荒凉，我们的专家们还是发现了一些前所未见的建筑材料。他们完成发掘和分析工作之后，样品将会送回进行进一步测试。
text.en: Though it is somewhat desolate, our specialists have found several uses of a building material they have never seen before. When they have finished their excavations and analysis of the area, samples will be brought back for further testing.

text.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一件我们此前从未见过的建筑材料。尽管应该无法直接使用，但我们可以将其带回去进行进一步分析。
text.en: Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have come upon a building material unlike any we have ever seen before. Though it is unlikely that it can be of use to us, it will be brought back to be analyzed further.

text.zh: 尽管没有在此处发现任何感性生物，我们的发掘人员还是在往深处挖掘时发现了一些无人机。它们已经严重受损，难以完整地进行逆向工程，但我们的技术人员相信这些分散的部件仍能给我们提供新的建造科技。
text.en: Though there are no sentient beings to be found, our excavators found several drones when they dug a bit deeper. Though they are damaged beyond the point of being able to be reverse-engineered in their totality, our technicians believe their disparate parts might teach us new building techniques.

text.zh: 我们的发掘[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些与我们自身集体意识底层相似的信号，再稍微深挖之后发现了两台老旧损坏的自动机器人。尽管损伤已经无法修复，但我们相信通过对它们的部件进行逆向工程，我们还是能对它们的建造方式有更多了解。
text.en: Our excavation [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon a signal similar to that which underlies our own shared consciousness, and after digging a bit deeper a pair of old broken automatons. Though damaged beyond repair, we believe we can reverse-engineer some of their parts to gain greater insight into how they once worked.

text.zh: 在废墟中筛选时，他们发现了一个曾存放着材料的小金库残骸，现在空无一物——很可能是很久以前就被海盗偷走的了。然而，其中还留下了一些关于原始居民如何开采这些相同材料的蓝图，这可能会派上用场。
text.en: As they were sifting through the ruins they found the remains of a small vault that once held materials, now empty - and most likely stolen by pirates, perhaps ages ago. They left behind some blueprints of how the original inhabitants had been mining these very same materials however, which might come in handy.

我们已经不再是当初那个由他们随意剥削的新生文明，现在，是时候让他们血债血偿了。

text.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的东西，我们的小队还是找到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文——至少根据上面的图画，他们自己是这么认为的。他们会将自己认为能够抢救的一切资料带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
text.en: Though not much of use was left behind, our team managed to find some research papers on geological activity from different planets - or at least so they think, based on the illustrations. They will bring everything they think can survive the journey back, to be deciphered as soon as possible.

text.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的材料，我们的工程无人机还是定位到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文。能够抢救的一切资料将会被带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
text.en: Though very few useful materials were left behind, our engineering drones did locate some research papers on geological activity from different planets. Everything that can survive the journey back will be returned, and deciphered as soon as possible.

text.zh: 我们的小队花了大量的时间试图攻破那个尚在运转的机器的防御，结果发现它们里面什么有用的东西都没有。不过，机器本身激起了他们的好奇心，他们会带一些部件回来。
text.en: Our team spent a significant amount of time trying to crack the defenses on those machines which are still active, only to find they contained nothing of real interest. The machines themselves have piqued their interest though, and they will bring some parts back.

text.zh: 我们投入了非常多的时间攻破那个发送信号的机器，现在可以肯定它藏有什么秘密尚未重见天日。无论我们能够回收什么部件，都会在第一时间将其带回。
text.en: After devoting a considerable amount of time to crack the defenses of the machines responsible for the signals, we now believe they may hold secrets yet to be divulged. Whatever parts we can salvage will be brought back right away.

text.zh: 他们发现一台可能制造了围绕该区域的薄弱屏障的机器——这可能是我们最初能找到这些东西的唯一原因。其他的东西一文不值，他们花了一些时间进行了拆解以期有所发现。
text.en: They found a small machine which seems to be responsible for a weak barrier surrounding the area - probably the only reason there's anything to be found in the first place. With nothing else of value there, they have spent their time picking it apart, to see what they can learn from it.

text.zh: 尽管缺乏保养或维护，但似乎有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的小队对此特别感兴趣，并将对其进行进一步调查。
text.en: It seems a fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of a lack of care or maintenance. Our team have taken a special interest in it, and will investigate it further.

text.zh: 尽管缺乏必要的维护，有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的工程子个体将对其进行进一步调查，以期能有所发现。
text.en: An old fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of the lack of necessary maintenance. Our engineering drones will investigate it further to see if there is anything we can learn from it.

text.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]分析曾点燃红巨星的$entropy_crystals$，一度险毁文明。现已可被重新设计改造，使其适用于工业体系、经济结构以及恒星级能源运输。

模拟结果显示，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而恒星系推动热膨胀。

特殊项目立项：$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$
text.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have analyzed the $entropy_crystals$ once used to ignite a Red Giant, an act that nearly ended our civilization before it began. We can now re-engineer this volatile substance to bind and transport vast thermal energy for industrial, economic, and stellar-scale use.

Simulations suggest it may enable terraforming into hotter climates or trigger stellar evolution into red giants. In theory, ambient galactic entropy could be reclaimed and converted into heat, driving systemic thermal expansion.

Issues Special Project: $INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$

default.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]报告发现一项全新技术，可将熵锁定于高能晶体阵列中储存。此$entropy_crystals$可存运大量热能，适用于工业、经济与星际用途。

模拟结果表明，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而系统推动全星系热膨胀。

特殊项目立项：$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$
default.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] report a novel method for harvesting and storing entropy by binding it into a high-energy crystalline matrix. This $entropy_crystals$ can store and transport substantial thermal energy, applicable across industrial, economic, and interstellar operations.

Modeling suggests that it might be used to terraform planets into hotter climates, or even in accelerating stellar evolution into red giants. In principle, stray entropy from across the galaxy could be reclaimed and converted into usable heat, driving compounding thermal expansion on a galactic scale.

Issues Special Project: $INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$

text.zh: 投资行星保护工作将起到应对波动的保障作用，有助巩固资产基础。但若我们转而选择利用增强的辐射，或许能够提升能源和工业指标。
text.en: An investment in planetary protection would act as insurance against volatility, and would help secure our asset base. But we might be able to boost our energy and industrial metrics if we pivot to harnessing the increased radiation instead.

default.zh: 防护恒星辐射可为我们争取更多时间。另一种方案更危险但潜力可观，即利用增强的辐射，提升能源和工业产能。
default.en: Protecting against stellar radiation can buy us more time. A more hazardous but potentially lucrative scheme would be to harness the increased radiation, boosting our energy and industrial sectors.

text.en: Through a complex process, it seems to be attached to a research drone. Circling a micro black hole located far below the planet's surface the drone has somehow managed to stabilize the singularity, perhaps in an effort to research it. Though we are unable to replicate this technological feat, we should be able to utilize the drone for our own means.

text.zh: [Owner.Species.GetHandNamePlural]中没有开采站，我们或许永远无法完全弄清发生了什么，但可以充分利用恒星收缩过程中释放的物质。
text.en: Without the station in our [Owner.Species.GetHandNamePlural], we may never understand precisely what happened, but we can make the most of any materials released by the star as it receded.

text.en: We are already being fueled by psionic energy drawn from the Shroud. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our destined potential.

text.zh: 因为虚境带来的影响，灵能之力对我们并不陌生。如果我们可以在整个[This.GetAdjective]社会规模上解锁灵能之力，就能完全获得我们应得的力量。
text.en: Psionic forces are not unknown to us, given the influence of the Shroud. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our latent potential.

text.en: For now, we can only endure.

default.en: The irreparably damaged vessel was able to generate some form of invisibility field and is generally far more tactically advanced than our own fleets.

text.zh: 在一切尽在掌控之中的情况下，民主派的指挥官们对他们的老对手进行了一场短暂的伪审判，然后把他们当作帝国的叛徒公开处决。
text.en: With everything under their control, the democratic commanders bring their old rivals through a short mock prosecution, before they are publicly executed as traitors to our empire.

text.zh: 在一切尽在掌控之中的情况下，民主派的指挥官们对他们的老对手进行了一场短暂的伪审判，然后征收巨额罚款后释放了他们。
text.en: With everything under their control, the democratic commanders bring their old rivals through a short mock prosecution, but most of them are released after receiving strict fines.

text.zh: 尽管一切都在民主派的掌控之中，他们的老对手却在混乱中消失了。没过多久，我们就收到了分裂主义运动在司令部许多老成员中不断发展的报告。
text.en: Though everything is under democratic control, their old rivals disappeared in the chaos. It does not take long before we receive reports of a growing separatist movement around many of the old members of the admiralty.

text.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们紧接着发表了一篇演讲，谴责他们的对手是煽动者、民粹主义者和卖国贼。势力最强的民主分子很快被处死，其余人则从公众视野中消失了。
text.en: After making their public announcement, it is followed by a speech denouncing their rivals as rabble-rousers, populists, and traitors. The strongest democratic elements are quickly put to death, with the rest disappearing from public view.

text.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们紧接着发表了一篇演讲，谴责他们的老对手。他们都被处以重罚，并被采取措施确保再也不会成为麻烦。
text.en: After making their public announcement, it is followed by a speech denouncing their old rivals. They are all heavily fined, and steps are taken to make sure they will never be a nuisance again.

text.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们对老对手的追捕很快就开始了，但毫无效果。在司令部办公室的混乱斗争之后，民主派几乎消失了。
text.en: After making their public announcement, the hunt for their old rivals quickly ensues, but to no avail. The democratic elements have all but disappeared after the chaos of the fight in the offices of the admiralty.

text.zh: 我们的传感器可是出了名地不靠谱。如果你们慷慨地送点能量币，也许我们就能……当做看错了。
text.en: Our sensors are notoriously fickle. A generous gift of credits might help us to... misread them."

text.zh: 退下。让你的领袖过来。来一场公平的决斗，[Species.GetName]和[Ruler.Species.GetName]。如果输了，我就把你们打下来。
text.en: Stand down. Send your leader. A clean duel, [Species.GetName] against [Ruler.Species.GetName]. If they lose we shoot you down."

text.zh: 说实话，悬赏你的合同还值不回这些弹药钱。开个更好的条件，不然就廉价地死去吧。
text.en: Frankly, the contract on your life is hardly worth the ammo. Make us a better offer, or die cheap."

text.zh:
一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，尽管其中虚境的影响确定五一。我们正在经历启示，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]命中注定成就伟大事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的群体性癔症，以及耳边低语着的统治星海的允诺。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
text.en:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, although the influence of the Shroud is unmistakable. We experience ongoing revelations that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

text.zh:
遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
text.en:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

text.zh:
我们的无人机网络内感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种囊括整个星系的思维。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。谨慎的做法是，我们要专心致志地寻找这些侵入性动机的根源。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
text.en:
We have sensed alien impulses within our drone networks - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we prioritize finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

default.zh:
我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种囊括整个星系的思维。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。谨慎的做法是，我们要专心致志地寻找这些侵入性动机的根源。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
default.en:
We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we devote our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

text.zh: 在除掉他们的对手后不久，他们决定将他们自己的政府政策强加给我们的帝国。
text.en: Shortly after getting rid of their opponents, they decide that they will impose their own government policies on our empire.

text.zh: 虽然他们已经除掉了他们的对手，并接管了我们的帝国，但似乎他们很乐意让事情像往常一样继续下去——至少现在是这样。
text.en: Though they have gotten rid of their opponents, and have taken charge of our empire, it seems they are happy to let things continue as normal - for now.

text.zh: 随着他们的对手离去，他们决定不仅要把自己的政策强加给我们的政府，而且还要让他们的老领袖亲自领导。
text.en: With their opponents gone, they decide that they are going to not only impose their own policies on our government, but also that their old leader is going to take personal charge of leading it.

text.zh: 它看上去同一个采矿装置连接在一起，后者用于开采一种罕见的、古怪的晶体矿脉类型，尽管现场没有任何标识说明是谁在负责这个设施。在经过一些轻微的调整之后，我们能够将其为己所用。
text.en: It seems to have been connected to the mining operations of an unusual and oddly off-putting type of crystal growth, though there is no sign of whoever must have been in charge of this facility. With some minor adjustments, we should be able to make use of it ourselves.

text.zh: 它引向了一个人工洞穴，里面满是精妙的晶体生物——可能这里是某种地下农场或者放牧地。由于很久以前就遭废弃，这些生物仅凭自身意愿随意蔓延生长。由于他们看上去很友好好客，如果我们有意愿，可以将这个农场恢复正常运转。
text.en: It led to a grotto teeming with delicate crystalline creatures - perhaps some sort of underground farm or breeding grounds. Long abandoned, the creatures are now free to roam as they wish. As they seem friendly and welcoming, we should be able to restore the farm if we so wish.

text.zh: 紧接着，一个摇摇欲坠的矿井出现在面前，里面满是无人机仍然在应付墙上的晶状体隆起物。它们完全没有因我们的出现受到影响，依旧不断地将大型集装箱填满并放到一边。尽管大多数晶体都是随处可见的类型，基本没什么价值，但是我们在中间找到了一些非常稀有的品种。
text.en: Following it revealed a rickety mine shaft filled with drones still hacking away at crystalline protrusions on the walls. Undisturbed by our presence, they worked continually to fill and set aside large crates. Though many of the crystals are common varieties and largely worthless, there are some rare ones to be found among them.

text.zh: 造成红巨星浩劫的缘由如今已无关紧要。我们能做的，只有接受既成事实，在废墟之上重建一切。
text.en: Whatever caused the Red Giant calamity is no longer relevant, all we can do now is accept our current state and rebuild from what is left.

text.zh:
恒星爆发造成的破坏抹去了追踪元凶所需的一切证据。

我们能做的，只有接受既成事实，在废墟之上重建一切。
text.en:
Disruptions by the stellar blast wiped out any evidence needed to track the culprit down.

All we can do now is accept our current state and rebuild from what is left.

default.zh:
残余外星人在破败开采站启动的进程终于走向了终结：[Target.GetStarName]发生新星爆发，几乎吞噬了整个恒星系。绚丽的等离子体与辐射将[event_target:red_giant_homeworld_tmp.GetName]，连同整个母星系，彻底摧毁殆尽。

[GetMegacorpDesc50]

[GetLususMiningDesc]
default.en:
The process begun by a remnant population of aliens in a degraded mining station has finally reached its conclusion: [Target.GetStarName] went nova, after engulfing nearly the whole system. Technicolor plasma and radiation scoured [event_target:red_giant_homeworld_tmp.GetName] clean, along with the rest of our home system.

text.zh: 他们在目标地点遇到了一艘坠毁的舰船残骸，仍然在不时地向外发送微弱的信号。
text.en: They came across the debris of a ship which had crashed at the location, still sending out weak signals every now and then.

text.zh: 他们找到了一座在轨的古老采矿站，似乎在很久以前就被其拥有者抛弃了。
text.en: They found an old mining station in orbit, seemingly abandoned by their owners a long time ago.

text.zh: 追逐微弱信号之旅带领着他们来到了一处空置的小型哨站，然而周边迹象显示某个技术水平和我们不相上下的存在新近在此地出现过。
text.en: The hunt for the weak signal led them to a small empty outpost, yet there were signs that someone of a similar technological level to our own had been there fairly recently.

text.zh: 在信标地址周边满是散落的船壳和其他垃圾，经判断肯定是某时刻来自于一个一度存在过的大型恒星基地——然而没有任何迹象表明附近有这样一个结构存在。
text.en: All across the signal beacon site were pieces of hull and other detritus which must have come from a larger starbase at one point - yet no other signs of such a structure remain.
We will learn much from this.

text.zh: 新的测试参数，令人激动。

随着我们沉入虚境，一个存在开始炙烤我们的内心幻景。弥漫的光芒笼罩了一切。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$正在灼烧着我们的内心。

它要求的不只是星系尺度的妥协、劣等异种之间的卑鄙和平。祂向我们许诺伟大的力量，只要我们肯接受这种可憎的愿景。

只要我们任其塑造新的视野。

月窠的光芒不屈不挠，祂的力量不可抵抗。
text.en:
As we sink into the Shroud, a presence sears our inner vision. The pervading glow obscures all else. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it burns within our core.

It demands no less than compromise on a galactic scale, an abject peace of incompatible beings. Great power awaits us, it promises, if we accept this detestable vision.

If only we will let it shape new horizons.

The Cradle's light is relentless, and its power is undeniable. Could our minds ever embrace such a thing? Will it weaken our resolve?

default.zh:
随着我们的心智沉入虚境，一个存在在我们的内心开始绽放。我们感受到了它的光芒点亮了一切，释放出秩序和平衡。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$，正在触动着我们的最深处。

祂想要的不仅仅是持久的和平——而是让星系摆脱混沌。如果我们共享祂的愿景，就可以使我们成为和谐的使者。祂承诺了牢不可破的信任。

只要我们任其塑造新的视野。

月窠的期望重重地落在我们身上。
default.en:
As our minds sink into the Shroud, a presence blooms within us. We sense a glow that touches all things, radiating order and balance. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it stirs us to our core.

It wants no less than enduring peace - a galaxy cured of its chaos. If we share its vision, it can forge us into bringers of harmony. It promises a bond of unbreakable trust.

If only we will let it shape our horizons.

The hopes of the Cradle press upon us.

text.zh: 据报道称这是由自发物灭现象而不是反常行为或失察引起的。
text.en: reportedly caused by spontaneous dematerialization rather than deviant or incompetent behavior

default.zh: 据报道称这是由自发物灭现象而不是犯罪或失察引起的。
default.en: reportedly caused by spontaneous dematerialization rather than crime or incompetence

text.zh: 我们发现自己处于$the_cradle_of_souls_article$与$the_composer_of_strands_article$的领域之间。
text.en: We find ourselves between the domains of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ and $the_composer_of_strands_article$.

default.zh: 我们发现自己处于虚境之中主要实体的领域之间。
default.en: We find ourselves between the domains of major entities within the Shroud.

text.zh: 随着我们跟上脚步，我们在地表的下面发现了泽珞的源头。来自外星文明的采集工具在房室的走廊上四散摆放，只要施加一点才智我们应该就能亲自使用这些工具。
text.en: As we continued to follow it, we found a source of zro buried deep below the surface. Exotic harvesting tools littered the chamber floor, and with a little ingenuity we should be able to make use of them ourselves.

text.zh: 它同一个埋藏在地表深处、已经不再运转的设施连接在一起。这个设施本身看上去似乎是打算调查一个泽珞的撞击点。尽管内部空空，绝大多数功能已经下线，将此地再次使用起来满足我们自己的目的应该是可行的。
text.en: It is connected to a defunct facility hidden in the depths below. The facility itself appears intended to survey a zro impact site. Though empty and largely offline, it should eventually be possible to reuse it for our own purposes.

text.zh: 就在[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地表之下我们发现了一处破旧的结构，因为时间的流逝被隐藏了起来。尽管它的结构某种程度上可以说完好无损，但是在建筑内部却没有什么值得回收的。不过，我们发现了一条通往地底更深处的通道。
text.en: Just beneath the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we found an dilapidated structure, hidden away by the passage of time. Though its framework remains somewhat intact, there is nothing worth salvaging inside the building itself. However, we have discovered a passage delving further underground.

text.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]找到了一群不知所措的小机器，它们仍在尝试完成设定的任务。这些机器聚集在一个被碎片和拆解的设备阻碍了的地点。主集线器已经下线并且基本失效，但有一个信号有规律地出现，明确地指引我们向地下探索。
text.en: We found a group of smaller, bewildered machines at [FromFromFrom.GetName], still trying to execute their designated task. The machines were grouped together at a focal point blocked by debris and dismantled equipment. The main hub is offline and mostly useless, though a signal occurring at regular intervals and leading deeper underground has given us a clear direction to follow.

text.zh: 我们此前对[FromFromFrom.GetName]的分析发现了一座位于地表上的坑洞附近的基础研究中心，通往一个巨大的地下洞穴。研究中心和其中的机械已经无法挽救，我们会着眼搜寻洞穴。
text.en: Our early analysis of [FromFromFrom.GetName] uncovered a basic research center around a hole on the surface that led to a massive underground cavern. With the research center and its machinery entirely unsalvageable, we have refocused on surveying the cavern.

text.zh: 对[FromFromFrom.GetName]地表进行详尽的调查后，我们发现了一个正在对该区域进行高密度扫描的探测器。无论我们做什么如何尝试交互，这个探测器都只会返回这一个地点继续原来的动作。依照它的行为模式，我们开始对地下的区域进行扫描。
text.en: After an exhaustive survey of the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we discovered a probe that was engaged in an intensive scan of the region. No matter what we do or how we try to interfere, the probe will inevitably return to that one spot to continue its operations. Following its pattern of behavior, we have begun to survey the ground beneath.

text.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]发现了一座古老的采矿站或是研究站的废墟。似乎它是在过去的某一时候坠毁于此的。同时其上还有着受到攻击的迹象。尽管受到了严重的损伤，这座空间站仍然将信号向地下传输。在继续下一步之前，我们毫无疑问应该对此进行深究。
text.en: We have come across an old and ruined mining or research station at [FromFromFrom.GetName]. It seems likely that this crashed to the surface at some point in the past. It also shows signs of having been attacked. Despite the extensive damage, the station is continuing to direct a signal underground. Before moving on, we should no doubt investigate this further.

text.zh:
对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经无可否认。许多[Root.GetIndividualPlural]的思想被所谓的星系和平所荼毒，在我们社会中产生了深刻的认知失调。

据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，交易的庇佑还没到来。而我们必须忍受这种可怕的思想冲突的困扰直到它到来为止。我们究竟对自己做了什么？
text.en:
The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already undeniable. The minds of many [Root.GetIndividualPlural] are poisoned by thoughts of galactic peace, causing profound dissonance throughout our society.

According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the blessings of this bargain are yet to come. Until that time, a terrible conflict plagues our minds. What is it that we have done to ourselves?

text.zh:
对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经可以探测。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对集体意识产生干扰。

这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。
text.en:
The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already detectable. As we aim for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes disturbance in the collective consciousness.

This small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.

default.zh:
对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经显而易见。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对大众造成痛苦。

这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。
default.en:
The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already apparent. As we yearn for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes distress throughout the populace.

This small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.

text.zh: 我们的维护单元正在尽一切努力力挽这种网络耗竭的狂澜。
text.en: Our maintenance units are struggling to stem the tide of neural network exhaustion.

text.zh: 我们的医疗机构正在力挽这种心智耗竭的狂澜。
text.en: Our medical institutions are struggling to stem the tide of psychic exhaustion.

default.zh: 我们的医疗机构正在力挽这种心智耗竭的狂澜。
default.en: Our medical institutions are struggling to stem the tide of psychic exhaustion.

text.zh: 在司令部的冲突达到顶点后，似乎民主派已经击退了他们的对手，因为他们控制了我们的许多中心学院。
text.en: After the conflict came to a head in the admiralty itself, it seems the democratic faction has beaten back their opponents, as they take control of many of our central faculties.

text.zh: 在司令部自身的冲突达到顶点后，似乎寡头派在酝酿中的冲突中取得了胜利，因为我们所有殖民地都在广泛宣布这一消息。
text.en: After the conflict came to a head in the admiralty itself, it seems the oligarchic faction has taken the victory in the brewing conflict, as a widespread announcement is shared across all our colonies.

text.zh: 虚境是否为神圣的次元？
text.en: Is the Shroud a divine dimension?

text.zh: 仅有唯一神明进行复数化身或是有复数神明？
text.en: Is there a unique multifaceted god or many?
Is the Spirit separate from the Soul?
What does it take to be a Holy World?

text.zh: 联合教会是否应有总主教？
text.en: Should there be a global head of a unified Church?

text.zh: 灵能是否为神触之力量？
text.en: Are Psionics touched by the divine?

text.zh: 什一税是否只应用于慈善？
text.en: Should tithes only be used for charity?

text.zh: 个人信仰是异端之源吗？
text.en: Is private faith the root of heresy?

text.zh: 弥赛亚审查。我们的救主是否仅为一名先知？
text.en: The Messiah Review. Were our saviors merely prophets?

text.zh: 泽珞族是否为神之信使？
我们自身是否蕴含着神圣？
text.en: Is divinity contained within us or without us?

text.zh: 何等美德可构成纯洁灵魂之基础？
text.en: Which virtues are the foundations of a pure soul?

text.zh: 一个工程师：拥有灵活的指头，敏捷的思维。十分擅长除法和线材！
text.en: An engineer: nimble fingers, swift mind. Very good with wires and long division!

text.zh: 一名拥有完美组织能力的行政官！十分聪明，很有远见。最喜欢在沙滩漫步！
text.en: An official of superb logistics! Very clever, thinks ahead. Likes long walks on the beach!

text.zh: 用于建造博物馆的图纸在我们家园的毁灭中幸存下来，我们希望与你们分享。
text.en: The schematics used for the construction of Museums have survived the destruction of our home, and we wish to share them with you.

default.zh: 我们愿意帮助你们在一颗行星上建立一座特别的博物馆。
default.en: We would like to assist you in building a specialized museum on one of your planets.

text.en: This is what makes us precious.
We are yet to be born.
All things die. Few things live.
We must first live before we can die.

text.zh: 我们怀抱回归之愿跨过这座桥。
text.en: We cross in hope of return.

text.zh: 尽管此处一片狼藉，我们的团队还是找到了一台完全没有被时间、野生动物或海盗所损伤的机器。它们相信只要能够尽快破译它，其中一定蕴含着能带来科学突破的秘密。
text.en: Despite the damage done to the rest of the location, our team managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. They believe it might hold the secrets of a scientific breakthrough, as soon as they can decipher them.

text.zh: 尽管此处其他部分七零八落，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是发现了一台没有被时间、野生动物或海盗损坏的机器。只要能尽快破译它，我们就有希望能从中发掘出深埋的秘密。
text.en: Though most of the location is falling apart, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. We hope that it might divulge some long forgotten secrets - once we manage to decipher it.

text.zh: 就在我们的团队要离开这个区域时，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。据我们的专家称，这些内容不但很容易破解，而且其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
text.en: As they were about to leave the area, our team came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they supposedly easy to decipher, but our specialists believe some of them might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

text.zh: 就在我们的维护[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]要离开这个区域前，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。这些内容不但很容易破解，而且我们相信其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
text.en: As we looked through the area one last time, one of our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they easy to decipher, but we believe they might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

default.en: Familiar treatments have proven ineffective, as the pain seems to cut straight to the psionic faculties through interdimensional channels we are only beginning to understand.

text.zh: 当他们搜索地址周边区域的时候，设法找到了一个看上去像是空救生舱的东西，里面还有一个未知的、外星生命体的残骸。他们打算尽可能快地将样品带回做进一步测试。
text.en: As they searched through the site, they managed to find a seemingly vacant lifepod with what looked like it the remains of an unknown, alien lifeform. They will bring the sample back for further tests as soon as they can.

text.zh: 我们之前捕捉到的信号读数来源于一台仍然以某种方式运转的机器，我们的小队设法从机器中提取到了一些有关制造它的文明的文件。由于我们先前对这个文明不甚了解，我们将其纳入了数据库——尽管他们看上去来自于一个更加古老的纪元。
text.en: One of the machines responsible for the signals we had picked up on was still somewhat operable, and our team managed to extract some files about the civilization it supposedly hails from. As they are previously unknown to us they will be entered into our databases - though they seem to be from a much older era.

text.zh: 尽管当地了无感性生命迹象，此地仍然是很多动物的繁育之地，而且这些动物看上去学会了使用破损的机械作为求爱展示的道具。我们的小队将会带回其中一部分以作进一步的留观。
text.en: Though uninhabited by sentient beings, it is the breeding grounds for a group of animals, who have seemingly learned to use some of the broken machinery as part of their courtship display. Our team will bring some of them back to be monitored further.

text.zh: 看上去当地的野生动物使用了部分内部机械作为它们求爱展示的道具。尽管我们通常对于这些动物毫无兴趣，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是将这些有趣生物的一部分带回作后续的留观。
text.en: It seems the local wildlife have started using the machinery from the interior as part of their courtship display. Though usually of little interest to us, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] will bring some of these curious beings back to be monitored further.

text.zh: 当他们对当前区域进行筛选的时候，他们遇到了一座小型图书馆，里面满是记载了各种当地动物的生物学细节的书籍，这些书籍来自许多原定居者曾经造访过的行星。我们的小队将会带回这些书籍，并开始破解书中使用的语言，并且将其中提取到的一切信息添加到我们的数据库。
text.en: As they sifted through the area, they came across a small library with books they think detail the biology of various local fauna, from the many different planets the original inhabitants had visited. Our team will bring them back and start deciphering the language used in the books, and add whatever information they can glean from them to our own databases.

text.zh: 在对该地点执行彻底搜寻之后，我们发现了一处图书馆。其中的书籍详尽地介绍了几千种外星植物的生物学细节，标本来自于原居住者造访过的每一个星球。我们会将这些书籍带回改善我们的数据库。
text.en: After scouring the location, we discovered a small library. The books inside detailed the biology of thousands of exo-fauna, specimens from each of the planets the original inhabitants visited. These will be brought back to improve our own database.

text.zh: 我本以为机械智能多少要和智能沾上点边，看来是没这回事了。
text.en: I thought that a Machine Intelligence would actually be intelligent, but apparently it is not the case.

text.zh: 都说集思广益，我看你们这个“集”也没能“思”个什么东西出来。
text.en: Many minds supposedly make light work, but your collective intelligence has amounted to precious little.

text.zh: 你们这些大只裸猿出发来太空旅游的时候是不是忘记把脑子带上了。
text.en: You thick-boned smooth-skins have developed interstellar travel yet common sense continues to elude you.

text.zh: 你们这群蠢兽比起我们伟大领袖的智慧和修养可是天差地别。
text.en: Beasts such as yourselves lack the intellect and refinement of our great leader.

text.zh: 虽然我一开始就没指望你们这群四脚蛇搞懂这种基本的概念。
text.en: Although, I would never expect you simple newts to understand such basic concepts as this.

text.zh: 可能你们的老祖宗啄树的时候把脑子给震坏了吧。
text.en: Perhaps your ancestors took one too many pecks to the cranium.

text.zh: 你们的外骨骼一开始就忘记把批判性思维的能力给包进去我是一点也不意外。
text.en: I am unsurprised that the ability to think critically has not penetrated your species' thick exoskeleton.

text.zh: 据说鼻涕虫是没有脑子的，看到你们以后我就知道这是真的了。
text.en: It is a fact that molluscs have no recognizable brain. Your species is evidence of that.

text.zh: 你们看起来像是一把连蘑菇都长不明白的孢子。
text.en: You seem to be a few spores short of a mushroom.

text.zh: 我看了你们以后是越来越明白为什么别的星球上的植物都不发展出智能了。
text.en: It is becoming increasingly obvious why plants have not developed intelligence on the majority of worlds.

text.zh: 你们真是蠢得和石头一样。
text.en: Your species truly is dumb as rocks.

text.zh: 你们可能复活的时候把智力给落下了。
text.en: You must be the husks of what once was an intelligent species.

text.zh: 你们的鱼脑离开了水就窒息了是吧。
text.en: You are clearly a fish out of water here.
An existence basking in filth has perhaps clouded your minds.

text.zh: 看来人格矩阵把你们的算力都给用完了。
text.en: Perhaps your individuality modules consume the majority of your processing power.

default.zh: 你们物种智力方面的灾难就跟你们的外貌一样惨烈。
default.en: Perhaps your species is as intellectually challenged as it is horribly disfigured.

text.zh: 对于求知者而言，生存即是通往理解之道。
text.en: For those who seek knowledge, the process of existence is a path to understanding.

text.zh: 其间如同海面，是一个包围虚境的无限小的虚空。我们可以在此窥见真理。
text.en: The Inbetween is the surface of an ocean, an infinitesimal void that bounds the Shroud. Here, one can glimpse truth.

text.zh:
无论生于何时，皆霎然如流星。
无论长于何处，皆脆弱如琉璃。
text.en:
Whenever it flourishes, life is fleeting.
Wherever they grow, the living are fragile.

text.zh: 心如泉水，思绪流过时空。我们汇入了另一个维度。
text.en: The mind is a spring, and thought flows through time and space. We drain into other dimensions.

text.zh: 一切果皆可由因循见。顺因缘而下便可知其果报。
text.en: The effect of any cause can be foreseen. To know the fate of things, one need only predict the lines.

text.zh: 恒星燃尽的一刻将亮过整个星河。万物亦然，终归于无。
text.en: At death, stars can shine brighter than galaxies. These things, too, shall fade.

text.zh: 星系聚处混沌称王。太虚却允诺着平和。
text.en: Chaos reigns where galaxies cluster. The void is a promise of calm.
A bridge can collapse any distance, and any bridge can be collapsed.
Every push is married to a pull.

text.zh:
星辰燃为烬，烬粉聚作云。
云中生银汉，银汉不异尘。
text.en:
A star dies, shedding dust; the dust forms a cloud.
From the cloud, a star is formed; the star's fate is dust.

text.zh: 未知催人探索，探索却使人盲目。
text.en: Explorers seek unknowns; exploration then blinds them.

text.zh: 内容之物无人晓，潜身其中不可回。
text.en: What lies within cannot be known. To dive within means no escape.

text.zh: 运动之物选择停下。那么代价是什么呢？
text.en: An object in motion chooses to rest. What should be its punishment?

text.zh: 据称出现在那里的幻象类似于我国古代传统宗教中的神明。
text.en: The ghostly figure that appears there is purported to resemble a sacred entity described in our ancient religious traditions.

text.zh: 这个地方吸引了越来越多想要一睹幽灵的游客。
text.en: The location has started to attract crowds of visitors who are eager to catch a glimpse of the ghostly figure.

default.zh: 这个地方吸引了越来越多想要一睹幽灵的游客。
default.en: The location has started to attract crowds of visitors who are eager to catch a glimpse of the ghostly figure.

text.zh: 现在到了讨论报酬的时候了。我们和……一些执法部门闹了些不愉快。都是小细节。并不重要。但是我们需要一些人来做我们的证人，提供一些帮助。强大而充满智慧的你们愿意为我们这些可怜的商人做担保吗，值得信任，非常无辜，我们只不过是稍微没注意做错了一点事，结果就被监管部门给盯上了嘶。
text.en: We have... run afoul of some legalities. Minor details. Very trivial. But we would require some witness, some support. Would your strong and wise nation vouch for us, poor trustworthy traders, very innocent, whose only mistake was a distraction of the mind, a mere oversight that led to the transgression of some pesky kssk legislature?

text.zh: 尽管城邦已经支离破碎，我们仍愿意为了星系保护向你们提供服务。我们会在你所选的领域进行帮助。
text.en: Despite the shattering of our enclave, we still wish to offer you our services in the interest of galactic preservation. We may assist you in the area of your choosing.

default.zh: 你们初步的收藏令人印象深刻，我们愿意为你们服务。为了星系的保护工作，我们将派遣一名专家在你所选领域提供协助。
default.en: Your initial collection is impressive, and we'd like to offer our services. In the interest of galactic preservation, we will dispatch a specialist to assist you in the area of your choosing.

text.zh: 一只凶猛的生物入侵了我们的科研船并试图杀死船上的舰载单元。没有军队帮助的话，他们撑不了多久的！
text.en: A savage organic beast has invaded our science ship and is trying to destroy our crew units. They won't last long without assistance from the military!

text.zh: 一只凶猛的生物入侵了我们的科研船并试图杀死船上的船员。没有军队帮助的话，他们撑不了多久的！
text.en: A savage creature has invaded our science ship and is trying to kill the crew. They won't last long without assistance from the military!

text.en: ruin, it laid forth a vision of senseless aggression.

text.zh: 的废墟之中，祂描绘了一中军事完美的模型。

default.zh: 和尸山血海之中，祂描绘了一种可怕而辉煌的军事天命。

text.zh: 对这片区域的进一步探索发现，它连接到一处似乎还在保持一定运转的远古设施。利用现有资源，这座机器继续在往外吐出锻造好的崭新而好用的合金锭。
text.en: Further exploration of the area revealed it is connected to an ancient apparatus somehow still continuing its operations. Using the resources on hand, the machine continues to spit out well-forged and entirely pristine bricks of useful alloys.

text.zh: 我们发现了一处奇怪的储存设施，其中塞满了支离破碎的舰船部件。尽管这些部件已经无可救药了，但我们可以把这些材料回收利用。
text.en: We have uncovered an odd storage facility filled with battered ship parts. Though the parts themselves are unsalvageable, we could possibly reuse some of the materials.

text.zh: 对这个区域的进一步调查发现了一处深藏于地下的机库。在库房里我们发现了一些已经残破不堪的舰船，上面丝毫找不到它们前主人的线索。恢复机库里的这些舰船相当困难，但我们应该可以抢救回一些对我们仍有用的部件。
text.en: Extended surveys of the region led to the discovery of a hangar bay hidden deep below ground. Around the rooms we find several decayed ships, with no signs of whoever once owned them. Though recreating the ships that once stood in the hangar will be difficult, we should be able to salvage the parts for our own purposes.

text.zh: 如果不加约束地任这种做法发展，可能会在被替换掉的子个体重新找到用处之前提升反常度。
text.en: Unfettered growth of this practice threatens to increase deviancy in the displaced drones while being repurposed.

text.zh: 如果不加约束地任这种做法发展，可能会在这个还在慢慢接纳灵能的社会里播下不和谐的种子。
text.en: Unfettered growth of this practice threatens to sow discord in a society still coming to terms with its psionic potential.

default.zh: 如果不加约束地任这种做法发展，可能会在这个还在慢慢接纳灵能的社会里播下不和谐的种子。
default.en: Unfettered growth of this practice threatens to sow discord in a society still coming to terms with its psionic potential.

text.zh: 由于某些原因，它似乎同某个埋在地下的废料处理站连接在了一起。这个站点十分古老，想要推测它的起源是不可能的事情，但我们相信可以收集一些这里的异星天然气为己所用。
text.en: For some reason, it seems to be connected to a waste disposal site deep below the ground. The site is so ancient that it will likely prove impossible to speculate on its origins, but we believe we can harvest some of these toxic gases for our own purposes.

text.zh: 它看上去同一个拥挤的研究设施连接在了一起，这个设施位于一个有毒天然气的自然产生点，气体不断地从[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地底喷涌而出。对这一设施进行重新调整应该可以让我们收集这一些气体为己所用。
text.en: It seems to have been attached to a crowded research facility centered around a natural occurrence of toxic gases stemming from the core of [FromFromFrom.GetName]. Readjusting the facility somewhat should allow us to harvest these for ourselves.

text.zh: 它引导着我们来到了远远深于地表之处，在那里我们遇到了一台规模大到难以置信的机器，很有可能是用于稳定[FromFromFrom.GetName]，但是现在已经损毁过重无法修复。尽管无法修整，这台处于损伤状态的机器能够产出某几种有毒气体，或许能对我们派上用场。
text.en: It led further below the surface where we came across a machine of incredible proportions, probably once used to stabilize [FromFromFrom.GetName], but now damaged beyond repair. Though unsalvageable, the machine's damaged state has led to the creation of several toxic gases that we might make use of.
